slides.title: Engagement Pathway
slides.task_brief: Engagement pathway. Top-left: text wordmark. Top eyebrow 'ENGAGEMENT PATHWAY' in --brand. Sora 700 headline 'A four-stage pathway from discovery to managed operations.' Subtitle (--text-secondary): 'Each stage carries concrete deliverables, fixed duration, and transparent commercial frame.' 4-column grid of FOUR .pathway-stage cards (~270x360, gap-4). Apply .pathway-stage.accent to card 4. Each card: .pathway-stage-num + .pathway-stage-name + .pathway-stage-meta + hairline-soft + 'DELIVERABLES' + list + .pathway-stage-fee. STAGE 01 'Discovery' meta '2 WEEKS · FIXED FEE'. Deliverables: 'Quality & Security Engineering maturity assessment', 'Opportunity prioritization', '90-day roadmap', 'ROI business case'. Fee: '$25K-$75K'. STAGE 02 'Solution Design' meta '3-4 WEEKS · FIXED FEE'. Deliverables: 'Target architecture', 'CoE charter', 'Governance framework', 'Build plan'. Fee: '$50K-$150K'. STAGE 03 'Delivery' meta '8-24 WEEKS · T&M OR FIXED'. Deliverables: 'Production system', 'Integration complete', 'Documentation', 'Knowledge transfer'. Fee: '$300K-$1M'. STAGE 04 'Managed Operations' meta 'ONGOING · RETAINER'. Deliverables: 'Managed services', 'Continuous optimization', 'Quarterly reviews', 'SLA-backed operations'. Fee: '$50K-$500K / mo'. NO pull-quote. NO CTA. Bottom rail (.bordered): text wordmark; center '10 / 12'; right 'ENGAGEMENT PATHWAY'.
